cards.title: gyrA E21Q

drug_site.pocket_definition: GyrA quinolone resistance-determining region, Mtb codons 74-113

conservation.headline: Glu in 34 of 58 sequences (M. tuberculosis and bacterial homologs)
conservation.counting: sequences with a residue at this position, M. tuberculosis included
conservation.label: moderately conserved

cards.synthesis: gyrA E21Q sits outside the QRDR, more than 20 Å from moxifloxacin in the structure, partly exposed (RSA 0.24), in a helix, more than 20 Å from the catalytic Tyr129. Glu in 34 of 58 sequences (M. tuberculosis and bacterial homologs); Gln in 4 (moderately conserved). The substitution is conservative (Grantham 29, BLOSUM62 +2). WHO catalogue v2: Levofloxacin group 5, Not assoc w R; Moxifloxacin group 5, Not assoc w R. Structural and evolutionary context only; it does not change the WHO catalogue call.

cards.title: katG frameshift at codon 382

truncation.note: Residues from this position on are altered; the protein ends at a downstream stop.

lof_tolerance.label: non-essential
lof_tolerance.source: DeJesus et al. 2017, mBio 8:e02133-16, Table S3 (H37Rv, in vitro, 7H9)
lof_tolerance.note: Essentiality in vitro: a non-essential gene can lose function and the bacterium still grows; an essential one cannot (in this assay).

cards.synthesis: katG frameshift at codon 382: about 48.5% of the 740-residue protein is lost or altered. Affected Pfam domains: Peroxidase (partly removed), Peroxidase (removed). 1 of the 21 catalytic-site residues (heme site (residues within 4 Å)) lie in the lost part. katG is non-essential in vitro by TnSeq. WHO catalogue v2: Isoniazid group 2, Assoc w R - Interim. Structural and evolutionary context only; it does not change the WHO catalogue call.
